name: Dropped Items
description: A dropped item that can be collected by a player.

fields.name: Drop Behavior
fields.description: Controls how the dropped item is created and placed in the room.

0.name: Create Copy
0.description: Creates a copy of the item and uses randomized position offsets.

1.name: Normal
1.description: The item lies on the ground or can be hidden under a rock.

2.name: Create Copy (Alternate Value)
2.description: Creates a copy of the item and uses randomized position offsets. This value is normalized to 0 during initialization.

3.name: Dropped
3.description: Represents an item that has been dropped and uses fixed position offsets.

fields.name: unknown 1
fields.description: An additional five-bit parameter. Its value is stored by the actor, but its purpose has not yet been established.

fields.name: unknown 2
fields.description: An additional five-bit parameter. Values above 3 are changed to -1 for most item types, but are retained for item types 11 and 22.
